calibration.metric: market evidence score, independent of age ranking
calibration.reason: Retained the previously deployed strict threshold 90; training-only sensitivity candidate 90 does not automatically replace production policy.

methodology.holdOverlap: No overlapping holds for the same card in each strategy.
methodology.benchmark: Buy every verified, fresh card across all prices with 90 days of usable history, irrespective of score.
methodology.previous: The prior score and Buy rule, evaluated on the verified, fresh, 90-day-history cohort across all eras; the original algorithm retains its original $100 limit; missing set peers do not exclude the prior model or benchmark.
methodology.hitDefinition: A positive market-price change after 30 days; unchanged prices count as failed signals.
methodology.drawdownDefinition: Largest peak-to-trough market-price decline during each hold.
methodology.execution: Signal-day market estimate to first provider observation on or up to three days after the horizon; no fees or slippage deducted.

sensitivity.deployment: Strict production gates retained. Alternative gates are research-only; held-out outcomes do not change the deployed rule.

caveats: Evaluation covers all qualifying market signals, not a budget-constrained portfolio following preference rankings. Age profiles change ranking, not signal eligibility.
Historical screening is not a promise of future returns. The Opportunity Score is not a hit probability.
The catalog and product matches are known today: survivorship, provider coverage and retrospective-match bias remain. Historical unavailable listings cannot be reconstructed.
TickerMint data begins in February 2024, even for cards released in 2008. Coverage and available history may be much shorter.
Market estimates are not completed sales or executable Near Mint listings; fees, shipping, tax and slippage can eliminate small gains.
Liquidity, listing depth and completed-sales volume are unavailable. Repeated provider prices do not prove actual sales or price stability.
Cards in the same set and market are correlated. Nonoverlapping holds within a card do not make different cards independent.
With fewer than 30 held-out signals across 10 cards, accuracy is too uncertain for validation. Zero Buy Now signals means there is no measurable Buy Now hit rate.
